message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or use `docker-machine start default`. But the user might want to start Docker Desktop via command line. We can use `& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"` or `Start-Process "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. Or use `docker start` to start a container. But they said "start Docker on window using docker start." That seems ambiguous. They might want to start the Docker service. So we can provide a command to start the Docker service: `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, we can start it via `Start-Process "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. Let's propose both.

We need to use the function to execute a command. We'll call the function with the command string. Let's choose `net start com.docker.service`. That will start the Docker service. We'll call the function.
